intro.text: Accendra Health, Inc. (f/k/a Owens & Minor, Inc.) and subsidiaries (Accendra Health, we, us, our or the Company) is a leading nationwide provider of products, technology, and services that supports health beyond the hospital for millions of people each year. We connect patients, providers, and insurers, delivering innovative solutions that help promote better health outcomes and improve quality of life for people living with chronic, complex, and acute health conditions. Together, our trusted brands, Apria and Byram Healthcare, bring nearly 90 years of combined experience in promoting health beyond the hospital in communities across the country. We are headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. The description of our business should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and supplementary data included in this Form 10-K.
